55.original: (-Xaela Hunter-)Caught in Isari, you say? I might go and take a look later.

56.original: (-Xaela Shepherd-)Have you ever had smoked fish from Isari before? I hear they're quite delectable.

57.original: (-Xaela Shepherd-)I've only had them the once, but I will never forget it. One of the tastiest meals I've ever had for sure. If someone's selling it in Reunion then I'll be first in line to buy some.

58.original: Hello again! I am pleased to say I have had a few customers stop by since you went off to spread word of my fish.

59.original: If business continues to be this good then I might have enough to buy some fur before heading home. The ocean breeze makes Isari a rather chilly place to live.

60.original: Oh, I cannot wait to go back and see my husband again. Thank you for all your help.
